StepAdder privacy

 • The only permission requested is Health Connect "Write steps".
 • It cannot read any of your health data, including your existing steps.
 • It has no internet permission, so nothing can leave your phone.
 • No account, no login, no analytics, no ads.
 • It stores nothing on disk. The "Undo" list lives in memory only and is cleared when the app closes.
 • Records are written to Health Connect on this phone. What happens after that is controlled by the apps you have allowed to read Health Connect (for example Google Health).

 You can revoke access any time in Settings → Security & privacy → Privacy controls → Health Connect → App permissions → StepAdder.
